title: RecordStore.Mark.holds skips the cloud-erase comparison once the store has no cloud erase, so a mark taken in the cloud still holds after the cloud disconnects (PR 1218 round 3, F6)
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Mark.swift:17 (erase == nil || now.erase == nil || ...). The Apple Health import no longer shows text for it (applyNow(_:on:) returns nil, a silent retry), but a pass can still land a cloud batch on the phone record across a disconnect when the epochs match. Fixing it changes the chat mark too (US-67 AC5), so not widened into PR 1218
